summary: Separate replication failure request timing, preparation costs and whole-attempt duration

replay.detail: Failure diagnostics remain host-local; no replay or projection changes.

schema.detail: No persisted schema or migration changes.

rules.detail: No changes to replication timeouts, retry policy, route selection or checkpoint coordination.

compatibility.detail: Replication status failure.elapsed_ms now preserves the originating failure's local measurement instead of being overwritten with whole-attempt time. HTTP timing starts immediately before send, after body preparation and compression. Optional attempt_elapsed_ms reports the worker's whole outbound attempt; preparation_ms reports the failing request's serialization, hashing, signing, compression and construction. Optional request_body_bytes reports HTTP body bytes after compression, while request_body_uncompressed_bytes reports serialized JSON bytes; neither includes headers or framing. Older records can omit these fields. Consumers requiring total attempt duration must use attempt_elapsed_ms rather than elapsed_ms.

downtime.detail: Normal binary rollout; no backfill or coordinated interruption.

manual.detail: No operator action required. Use the separate timing scopes and body byte counts when diagnosing replication stalls.

recovery.detail: Ordinary binary rollback restores prior diagnostics without changing durable state.
